findings.description: tag_chip.dart hardcodes BorderRadius.circular(8) instead of reading theme.extension<SnapFoodShapes>()?.chip. TagChip is used on every results card, detail banner, and scan chips — if the chip token changes it won't follow.
findings.action: Inject SnapFoodShapes in TagChip.build and use shapes?.chip ?? 8.0.

findings.description: detail_screen.dart _StepRow step-number container hardcodes BorderRadius.circular(8) rather than reading SnapFoodShapes.chip.
findings.action: Read theme.extension<SnapFoodShapes>()?.chip ?? 8.0 for the badge border radius.

findings.description: empty_state.dart illustration container uses BorderRadius.circular(24) with no backing token in SnapFoodShapes.
findings.action: Add an illustration or badge radius token to SnapFoodShapes, or document the 24dp value as an intentional one-off constant.
